hook.name: PhiEthHooks
hook.description: Implements a 1:1 custom-curve swap between ETH and phiEth (a 1:1 ETH wrapper). On every swap, the hook takes the full input from the PoolManager, converts it via phiEth.deposit/withdraw, and settles the output directly, bypassing the concentrated liquidity mechanism entirely. Liquidity addition to the pool is permanently blocked.
